nodes.label: pnpm Workspace Config
nodes.rationale: Pins sharp>=0.35.0 (libvips CVEs) and postcss>=8.5.12 (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q) forward past Next's declared ranges; adds pnpm 10.16+ supply-chain hardening (7-day minimumReleaseAge, blockExoticSubdeps, trustPolicy no-downgrade).

nodes.label: Dependabot Config
nodes.rationale: Groups minor/patch updates into one monthly PR, ignores auto major bumps (done manually), 7-day cooldown; security CVE fixes still arrive as separate PRs.

nodes.label: Publish Workflow (npm on v* tag)
nodes.rationale: Triggers on v* tags; gates release on check-types + test; writes NPM_TOKEN to ~/.npmrc explicitly because pnpm publish does not reliably read setup-node's NODE_AUTH_TOKEN.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages Deploy Workflow
nodes.rationale: Static-exports apps/backoffice to Pages; deliberately avoids configure-pages static_site_generator:next because it injects a basePath that breaks /_next assets on the root custom domain vui.viliha.com.

nodes.label: Backoffice next.config.js
nodes.rationale: output:'export' for GitHub Pages (no Node server), images unoptimized, trailingSlash to emit clean /route/index.html; turbopack root pinned to repo root so a stray ~/pnpm-lock.yaml doesn't make Next infer $HOME as workspace root.

nodes.label: block-main-push.sh PreToolUse Hook
nodes.rationale: Enforces the branch + PR flow by blocking any git push targeting the protected main branch; exit 2 aborts the Bash tool call.

nodes.label: @viliha/vui-ui Component Library
nodes.rationale: Shipped as TypeScript source with no build step so the consuming app's bundler tree-shakes and compiles only imported entry points (@viliha/vui-ui/<name>).

nodes.label: theme.css Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Single stylesheet of CSS variables (color, typography, radius, dark mode, chart/sidebar tokens); restyle the whole system by editing tokens in one place and shadcn components inherit them automatically.

nodes.label: Manual-mode internalRows reconciliation effect
nodes.rationale: In server (manual) mode with an uncontrolled table, RecordView seeded internalRows from initialData once and never reconciled, so post-mutation refetches and narrowed filters kept showing stale rows. The effect re-syncs internalRows whenever the initialData seed changes (isManual && !controlled), leaving the controlled data path untouched.

nodes.label: RecordView 1.37.1 server/manual mode fix
nodes.rationale: 1.37.1 (2026-08-03) fixes two RecordView server-mode defects: manual-mode rows now reflect writes and filters without a manual reload by re-syncing on initialData seed change, and a filtered-empty result reads 'No matching records.' instead of the first-run 'No records yet.'
